# Spam ML API 🚀

A machine learning microservice built to classify SMS messages as spam or ham (normal). 

## 🏗️ Project Structure
* **`app/`**: Contains the FastAPI web server, routing, and Pydantic validation schemas.
* **`ml/`**: Contains the machine learning pipeline (Scikit-Learn) and dataset loading logic.
* **`models/`**: Stores the compiled model (`.joblib` file) generated by the training script.
* **`.github/workflows/`**: Contains the automated CI/CD pipelines.

## 🧠 How to Train the Model
To generate the machine learning model, I wrote a pipeline using a TF-IDF Vectorizer and Logistic Regression. 
To train it locally, run:
`python -m ml.train`
*(This will output a model.joblib file and a metrics.json file).*
